outcome: Stage of AKI (based on RIFLE criteria)
cohort: 173 newborns admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) at Boo-Ali-Sina Hospital in Sari, Iran, during 2016-2018
finding: AKI was common in the NICU, accounting for about one-fourth of admitted patients, with the most common type being prerenal, and anemia, hypernatremia, and hyperkalemia were identified as risk factors.
